value.rationale: The complete-split join K_a ∨ independent b is a canonical graph with a dense and sparse community. Its exact nine-class temporal census exhibits a nontrivial equal three-layer oscillatory entry identity, an independent-set-only sharp fourth extinction population, and a tunable limiting four-layer distribution (uniform for a=3). These count genuine first-entry times, not just generic attractor existence, and provide a motivated invariant for all a>=3,b>=2.
